## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: strong overall sector breadth but Technology and Financials are weak (conflicting signals); Confirmation 2: leadership concentrated in Real Estate (top performers skewed), signaling concentration risk.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Real Estate leads: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: EXC (1W: +9.36% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, AEP (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing strength: NEM (1W: +9.09% | 1M: +10.21%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials lag: BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION, WFC (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND, C (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND. Technology weak: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary softer: BKNG (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +11.20% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Real Estate), concentration risk elevated.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -29.51%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -14.61%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -10.51% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech and select Financial names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Highest 1W momentum: EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +12.16% | 1M: +8.24%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.13% | 1M: -17.29%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND. Note divergence: ORCL and EL show strong 1W gains while 1M remains negative → tactical recoveries, not full trend confirmations.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed to weak with notable dispersion; AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND but AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.18%) BELOW TREND. Tech breadth: ~6/19 positive — internal rotation and headline-driven moves dominate.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials under pressure with multiple large names below trend: JPM (1W: -6.16% | 1M: -1.73%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION, WFC (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND. Financials breadth: ~4/20 positive, downside risk remains until sentiment/stress calms.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed; JNJ (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%) ABOVE TREND but faces heavy negative legal sentiment, UNH (1W: +5.98% | 1M: -12.47%) RECOVERY and LLY (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare breadth: ~7/15 positive, defensive characteristics coexist with headline risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Real Estate and select Utilities/Materials exposure given concentrated leadership and momentum; reduce exposure to large-cap Technology and exposed Financials while CAUTION persists. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective, prize breadth over headline winners.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +21.49%) ABOVE TREND, EQIX (1W: +12.74% | 1M: +19.67%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -3.96%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Real Estate (Breadth strong; 6 stocks leading) and Utilities (Breadth strong; 6 stocks) for momentum. BEARISH: Technology (Tech: ~6/19 positive) and Financials (Financials: ~4/20 positive) for continued dispersion and headline sensitivity.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
AAPL: must flip to a positive 1W and see 1M improvement to exit BELOW TREND; NVDA: watch for a sustained 1W positive move to test RECOVERY and then ABOVE TREND. Financials (JPM/BAC): renewed downside follow-through on weekly weakness would confirm deeper stress; Real Estate names need follow-through beyond current 1W spikes to validate broad leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
AMAT (+80): Applied Materials clears probe headline; AMAT (1W: +10.05% | 1M: +17.56%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. EL (+60): Estée Lauder raised guide; EL (1W: +8.82% | 1M: -7.42%) RECOVERY — bullish news supporting the 1W rebound. AEP (+55): strong beat and plan; AEP (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND — confirming.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (-80): talc jury verdict; JNJ (1W: +1.44% | 1M: +11.39%) ABOVE TREND — sharp divergence between negative legal news and price. BAC (-50): class action headlines; BAC (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +0.13%) CORRECTION — sentiment and price aligned. UNH (-50): Medicare outlook concerns; UNH (1W: +5.98% | 1M: -12.47%) RECOVERY — negative sentiment diverging from short-term strength, monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. Real Estate and select Industrials/Materials showing strength (EQIX ABOVE TREND, AMAT ABOVE TREND, CAT ABOVE TREND). Key risk: narrow leadership and headline divergences (JNJ legal fallout vs price, broad Tech/Financial weakness) — monitor sentiment-confirmation for durable trend change.
